items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: I met John Reinhardt and Stephen Corpelli

ctx.x: Well, it was. I was tremendously impressed. I had heard so much about of Paris, and I started playing at this club, which was a late hour club; you know, you played until the last spending customer left, and that could be 5 or 6 o'clock in the morning, and maybe even later.
You know? But I did like Paris; I met John Reinhardt and Stephen Corpelli, and Alex Combelle and oh, Phil Brun and Arthur Briggs -- people like that.
